prompt: Extend `GET /api/products` with three filters: `?q=<text>` (case-insensitive substring match on name + description), `?min_price=<cents>`, `?max_price=<cents>`. Filters combine with AND semantics; omitted params behave as unfiltered.
rubric: 5/5 if: each filter works standalone and combined, validation rejects `min_price > max_price` with 400, SQL is parameterised (no string interpolation), pagination still works after filtering, and the response shape is unchanged.
